rebalancing_study.pdf.title: Rebalancing Frequency and Portfolio Weights: AAPL / TSLA
rebalancing_study.pdf.summary: A two-dimensional study of rebalancing schedules versus AAPL/TSLA weights on a frozen 2020–2025 sample. Weight dominates the risk profile; frequency changes the path and cost, but is not monotonic.

02_threshold_partial_rebalancing.pdf.title: Trade Less, Rebalance Selectively
02_threshold_partial_rebalancing.pdf.summary: Threshold triggers and partial corrections on AAPL/TSLA 50/50. A 3.75 pp band with 20% correction cuts holdout trades by about 62%, but holdout CAGR trails weekly 50/50 — an implementation tradeoff, not a free improvement.

03_time_and_asset_robustness.pdf.title: Does Rebalancing Travel Well?
03_time_and_asset_robustness.pdf.summary: Entry dates, holding horizons, and asset pairs. Weekly AAPL/TSLA often beats buy and hold in this sample, yet several ETF pairs show the opposite, especially over five years.

04_rebalancing_mechanisms.pdf.title: What Does Rebalancing Earn?
04_rebalancing_mechanisms.pdf.summary: Separates diversification growth from endpoint concentration. A positive diversification term does not guarantee beating buy and hold; the balance of the two effects sets the frictionless terminal advantage.
